g_pixelFormatFilled.comment: bit 0 set once gfx_setPixelFormat has filled the game's pixel format descriptor (0x4b1020: (g_videoDepth + 1) x 16 colour bits, 16 depth bits)

k_setupPanelEnd.name: k_panelSlideEnd
k_setupPanelEnd.comment: the double -1649.9: a menu panel slide ends once the tunnel depth is no longer above it (setup_easePanel; menu_slide for the arena lobby and the game room); the depth is then set to -1650

k_setupPanelTarget.name: k_panelSlideTarget
k_setupPanelTarget.comment: 250.0: the value a menu panel slide eases toward (setup_easePanel's g_setupPanelPos; menu_slide's g_lobbySlideEase / g_unusedRoomPanelEase)

g_coloursChanged.comment: a colour slider was set where the pointer clicked (armc_colours.c: the hue / saturation / value setters set 1, on a click only); armc_updatePartsPreview then applies the colour slot (armc_applyColourSlot) and clears it

g_viewFov.comment: the match view's vertical field of view in degrees (gluPerspective fovy in gfx_setMatchProjection; stage_setupView); 90 in the exe's data; view_fov / view_setFov; zoom_view moves it within 10 .. 60

g_mapTop.comment: the first map shown in the arena's map rotation list (up to 10 rows from it; arena_maps.c, scrolled by its arrows)

g_armcAngle.comment: the ARM CENTER preview's turn in tenths of a degree, 0 .. 3600: + frame time x 8 while g_armcSpin, back to 0 at 3600; drawn as x 0.1 degrees (armc_misc.c preview, armc_drawPreview3D)

g_repeatUp.comment: time units until a held Up key steps again (key_repeat: 4 after a step, less g_frameTime, 0 when released; g_repeatDown the Down key's): replaySelect_keys, missions_listKeys, profileList_keys; cleared by menuState900_enterMissions

g_pickedGame.comment: the game picked in the arena lobby's / game room's game list: an index into g_sessionList (g_gameListTop + g_gameListRow); joined with arena_joinSession / room_joinListed, its password and lock checked

g_missionTop.comment: the first mission shown in the (unused) mission list: up to 8 rows from it (missionList_draw), g_missionPicked = it + g_missionRow; 0 from menuState900_enterMissions

g_logOutDialogX.comment: left of page 5's (log-out question) dialog frame, 120 (menuState210_enter); with g_logOutDialogY / Right / Bottom; logOutDialog_layout places its buttons from it

g_profileDialogX.comment: left of page 3's (delete question) dialog frame, 120 (menuState210_enter); with g_profileDialogY / Right / Bottom; deleteDialog_layout places its buttons from it

g_desktopW.comment: the desktop's width before the first mode switch (glWindow_setDisplayModeBy: GetDeviceCaps HORZRES); put back by glWindow_restoreDisplayMode (with g_desktopH, g_desktopBits)

g_white.comment: the packed opaque white colour ff ff ff ff as one word (the same four bytes as objects.h g_packedWhite, colour_initPackedWhite): point and mark colours (skel_data.c, frame_loops.c)

g_randTable.comment: int[4096]; the game's random table (rand() values 0 .. 32767): each draw takes entry g_randPos & 0xfff (rand_below and the match's random helpers); 0x4000 bytes up to g_tanTable

g_createArena2Rects.name: g_hostErrorBoxRects
g_createArena2Rects.comment: int[8]; the create-arena screen's NETWORK INITIALIZE ERROR box's two buttons (createArena_layout; createArena_hitTest numbers them 16 / 17 while g_hostErrorBox is up)

g_arenaDialogBoxRects.comment: int[4]; the arena list's CONNECTING TO THE GAME SERVER box's CANCEL button, MSG(116) (arenaDialogBox_layout; arenaDialogBox_hitTest)

g_arenaCreateRects.name: g_arenaUpdateNoticeRects
g_arenaCreateRects.comment: int[8]; the arena lobby's THIS PROGRAM HAS BEEN UPDATED notice's two buttons (arenaUpdateNotice_layout; arenaUpdateNotice_hitTest)

g_gameListStopRects.name: g_gameListJoinBoxRects
g_gameListStopRects.comment: int[4]; the game room list's CONNECTING TO THE GAME SERVER box's CANCEL button (gameListJoinBox_layout; gameListJoinBox_hitTest)
